name: Postman
tagline: API development platform with request builder, collections, testing, and documentation
verdictSummary: An HTTP client is one of the simplest dev tools to build. A fetch() wrapper with URL input, method selector, headers editor, JSON body editor, and response viewer (status, headers, formatted body) is a one-sitting project. VS Code extensions like Thunder Client prove how simple this is.
coreLoopDIY: HTTP request builder with method/headers/body inputs and formatted response viewer
moatNotes: Postman's moat is the team collaboration — shared collections, workspaces, and the API lifecycle management beyond just making requests
whyPeopleStillPay: Shared API collections across teams, automated testing, and generated documentation for API-first development workflows
notes: Hoppscotch is already the open-source answer. Building your own is a great learning exercise.
